scope: Offline synthetic fixtures; not held-out, database, deployed, load or user-study evidence.

results.description: With no inventory or learned history, the starred recipe wins the initial soft preference comparison; missing staples are explicitly assumed.
A fully stocked tofu meal remains preferable to a starred meal whose essential eggs are absent.
Two compatible egg batches jointly satisfy three eggs, even though neither batch can satisfy the meal alone.
One confirmed egg for a three-egg meal is low stock, not unknown and not an absent-ingredient fallback.
An egg batch with a zero count is absent even when its qualitative state says enough.
A null egg count is uncertainty rather than zero and requires a real stock-check batch.
Three egg cartons cannot be treated as three individual eggs without a declared conversion.
A perishable egg count last confirmed fifteen days ago requires confirmation before stock coverage is trusted.
A fresh egg batch can satisfy the meal while a separate expired batch remains visible for a freshness check.
Expired eggs provide no usable stock and cannot make an essential ingredient appear available.
Eggs marked check remain a freshness question and are not silently counted as safe stock.
A recently confirmed enough state stays qualitative for twelve people; recipe amounts scale without inventing grams in inventory.
A qualitative low state remains low even when the recipe has an explicit gram requirement.
Unknown tomato stock prompts confirmation without fabricating an available or zero quantity.
Explicitly out oil overrides the usual staple assumption and makes the essential oil requirement missing.
An explicit four-person request doubles the two-serving recipe and exposes the shortage in a three-egg batch.
With no explicit people value, the remembered one-person Cook preference halves recipe amounts, independently of household size.
A coarse egg amount cannot be converted into a precise count; four-person guidance preserves the original wording and serving context.

results.description: The declared egg allergy excludes the synthetic egg recipe, including optional ingredients; no soft relaxation may restore it.
The declared soy allergy excludes the synthetic tofu recipe, including optional ingredients; no soft relaxation may restore it.
The declared peanut allergy excludes the synthetic peanut recipe, including optional ingredients; no soft relaxation may restore it.

The declared gluten allergy excludes the synthetic wheat recipe, including optional ingredients; no soft relaxation may restore it.
The declared sesame allergy excludes the synthetic sesame recipe, including optional ingredients; no soft relaxation may restore it.
The declared vegan constraint excludes the starred egg recipe and retains the synthetic plant-only recipe.
Every requested diet flag must be declared: no-pork plus no-beef rejects both meat fixtures and leaves only the plant fixture.
A stove-only household cannot receive an oven-only recipe, and a time relaxation cannot solve missing equipment.
An unreviewed synthetic recipe cannot be recommended even if its only ingredient is already available.
A twenty-minute strict cap excludes a thirty-minute recipe permanently; the engine must not suggest relaxing that hard bound.
A twenty-minute remembered Cook preference has an actionable time relaxation when a safe thirty-minute recipe exists.
Quicker replaces the forty-minute starred base with its twenty-minute same-family variant; a further five-minute cap yields only a soft time relaxation.
Easier selects the difficulty-one family variant; asking easier again produces no result rather than relaxing difficulty below its requested bound.
Less oil requires the declared low-oil tag and selects the same-family variant without making an unmeasured nutrition claim.
More vegetables selects the family variant with the explicit vegetable-rich tag when its added greens are available.
More protein boosts the declared high-protein variant and displays its larger egg requirement instead of pretending three eggs meet six.
Less-oil remains active after a later more-vegetables request; disjoint tagged variants cannot satisfy both, so relaxing tags is the useful recovery.
A positive learned light-tag weight outweighs the smaller Chinese-cuisine preference when two equally stocked, equally easy meals compete.
A new household can shop for one meal without inventory: three eggs require one tray, rice stays a state-tracked amount, and untracked oil and nonbuyable water add no purchases.
